reason: Verified per-site (RFC 0106): `others.empty?` / `scope.references_values.empty?` / `associations.empty?` (join_association.rb:47, :50, :65) — `empty?` on Ruby Arrays, whose faithful JS spelling is `xs.length === 0`. That emits no callee, so no TS call can ever credit the Ruby one. Surfaced only when `join_constraints` stopped reading `where_clause.empty?`, a call Rails never makes here.

Verified per-site (RFC 0106 wave 4g): `arel.constraints.first` (join_dependency/join_association.rb:56) is index-0 access on a Ruby Array, spelled `arel.constraints[0]` (join-association.ts:147). `Array#first` is a positional idiom with no JS call form — deliberately uncredited by RFC 0092 (JS_ENUMERABLE_ALIASES) — so nothing was dropped from the TS body.
